packages.dependency_framework_evidence: For the requested net10.0 dependency target, dotnet-inspect selected the .NETStandard2.0 manifest group. That group directly declares Polly with version range 7.2.4. It also declares Microsoft.Extensions.Http 10.0.12 and Polly.Extensions.Http 3.0.0.

answer.scope: The Microsoft.Extensions* query inspected 40 of 40 allowed candidates and returned one match. dotnet-inspect reported CandidateLimitReached and explicitly said the results do not exhaust the requested package-ID scope. This is one evidenced package, not a complete inventory of the family or indirect dependencies.

uncertainty: Only direct declared dependencies were queried. The candidate limit prevents a claim about all Microsoft.Extensions packages; no indirect-dependency survey was performed. The manifest value 7.2.4 is reported as a declared version range, not as a restored or installed version.
discovery_schema_navigation_friction: The command help described --where but not the full dependency semantics, so -Q Packages was needed to identify depends and dependency-target. The result provided the selected manifest group and its dependencies inline; no package-detail navigation was needed.
